{{Quote|Huttbreaker, she led the revolt, so now she runs the docks. She'll vote for you--fuel sales go straight to her pocket. So you just need one more vote.|[[Junker Jott]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
The '''Mek-Sha docks''' were docks located within the [[Asteroid base|asteroid station]] [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="TOR:DtD" /> They were controlled by [[Huttbreaker]] after [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion|Mek-Sha rebellion]] against the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Twenty-Ninth Fleet|29th Republic Fleet]] planned to refuel at Mek-Sha before sailing to the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] to participate in the decisive [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" /> Imperial forces therefore [[Mission to Mek-Sha|invaded]] the docks of Mek-Sha in order to prevent the refueling of the Republic reinforcements. Eventually, the Sith were defeated by the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and their Republic allies, allowing the Republic ship to refuel safely.<ref name="TOR:DtD" />
